name: CMSC 2027 Annual Meeting
description: The Consortium of Multiple Sclerosis Centers holds its 2027 annual meeting at the San Diego Convention Center in San Diego, California, from 2 to 4 June 2027. The meeting brings together clinicians and researchers working in multiple sclerosis care.

sources.note: Confirms dates, venue, and city; direct fetch returned HTTP 403, content retrieved via r.jina.ai proxy.
Independently confirms 2 to 4 June 2027 in San Diego; content retrieved via r.jina.ai proxy after a direct HTTP 403.

notes: www.mscare.org/2027 redirects (HTTP 301) to cmscscholar.org/cmsc-2027-annual-meeting/. Direct WebFetch of cmscscholar.org pages returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; content was retrieved via the r.jina.ai proxy instead, from two separate official CMSC Scholar pages that agree on 2 to 4 June 2027. Some aggregator sites (10times, eMedEvents) instead list the end date as 5 June 2027; the official pages were preferred here. No abstract or registration deadlines are published yet.
